dom.heading: Flying buttress
dom.term:
Flying buttress

An arched prop outside the building. It carries the outward push of the high vault over the side aisles to a heavy outer pier, so the upper walls no longer need to be thick.

Named for Notre-Dame de Chartres: “The building's exterior is dominated by heavy flying buttresses which allowed the architects to increase the window size significantly” Source
